translations.web: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.
translations.bsb: Every living creature, every creeping thing, and every bird—everything that moves upon the earth—came out of the ark, kind by kind.
translations.kjv: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.
translations.asv: every beast, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatsoever moveth upon the earth, after their families, went forth out of the ark.
